description: Three new files: R/filter_helpers.R (filter-inversion bug -- '!=' where '==' was intended, so keep_completed() drops completed jobs instead of keeping them), R/label_helpers.R (clean, no issues), tests/testthat/test-filter_helpers.R (the test itself asserts the wrong/inverted behavior, so it passes against the bug). Exercises multi-file surface area for a single review.
